Daily energy flow

Where energy moved 2026-10-23

⇣12.6kWh imported
M01 from NYSEG
i
Imported / M01 is electricity NYSEG delivered to the home. It raises grid dependence and contributes to NYSEG energy charges at your import rate.
☀32.7kWh produced
SunRun solar
i
SunRun production is all solar energy generated. Energy used in the home avoids importing from NYSEG; any surplus becomes M02 export credit.
⌂19.8kWh estimated
home consumed
i
Home consumption is estimated as solar production + M01 import − M02 export. Higher use increases the solar energy needed to avoid NYSEG purchases.
⇡25.5kWh exported
M02 to NYSEG
i
Exported / M02 is surplus solar sent to NYSEG. It reduces net grid use and creates value or credit under your net-metering billing rules.
